related.description: High performance self-hosted photo and video management solution.
A self-hosted non-invasive single-binary photo gallery with a focus on speed and simplicity.
A fast directory-first photo gallery website, with rich UI,  optimized for running on low resource servers (especially on raspberry pi)
Fast, modern and advanced photo management suite. Runs as a Nextcloud app.
Manage your photos with Piwigo, a full featured open source photo gallery application for the web. Star us on Github! More than 200 plugins...
